mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for two consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains above for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns show no statistically significant negative relationship with the FEDFUNDS rate change (p > 0.05 in OLS).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 new jobs per month for three consecutive months triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days due to increased consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 200000 and remains above for three consecutive months
failure_condition: Empirical power of the PAYEMS threshold signal is weak (R-squared < 0.05 in a regression of 20-day SPX returns on PAYEMS threshold).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer demand proxies like HOUST (units shipped) by over 10% in a single month leads to a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates sustained sales growth.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between HOUST monthly change >10% and subsequent 5-day SPX returns (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 102.0 suggests supply chain expansion, which when combined with falling inflation (CPIAUCSL < 325), creates a positive 20-day S&P 500 return through dual positive momentum channels.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 102.0 and CPIAUCSL remains below 325 for the next month
failure_condition: Interaction term between INDPRO and CPIAUCSL is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4% for 4 consecutive months indicates labor market softening, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as investors anticipate rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% and remains below for four consecutive months
failure_condition: UNRATE declines do not precede statistically significant negative 60-day SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising job openings (RSAFS) above 750,000 create a positive 20-day S&P 500 return as it signals labor market resilience and demand recovery.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS crosses above 750000 and remains above for two consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant positive return predictability from RSAFS threshold in out-of-sample tests (walk-forward p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5% for three consecutive months in a deflationary regime (CPIAUCSL < 320), the S&P 500 is expected to deliver positive 5-day forward returns as rate-cut expectations rise.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 320 and FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant positive return when CPIAUCSL < 320 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5% (p > 0.05 in out-of-sample).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 5% for two consecutive months is accompanied by a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals demand softening and potential overcapacity.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant negative return when INDPRO declines by >5% for two months (p > 0.05 in OLS).
